name: terrain flat FS
on: const m = window.__cw.app.world.terrain.mesh.material; m.defines = { ...(m.defines || {}), DEBUG_FLAT_FS: '' }; m.needsUpdate = true;
off: const m = window.__cw.app.world.terrain.mesh.material; delete m.defines.DEBUG_FLAT_FS; m.needsUpdate = true;

name: forest leaves hidden
on: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) n.leaves.visible = false;
off: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) n.leaves.visible = true;

name: forest bark hidden
on: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) n.bark.visible = false;
off: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) n.bark.visible = true;

name: impostors hidden
on: for (const o of window.__cw.app.world.forest.root.children) if (o.name.startsWith('imp_')) o.visible = false;
off: for (const o of window.__cw.app.world.forest.root.children) if (o.name.startsWith('imp_')) o.visible = true;

name: leaves no A2C
on: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) { n.leaves.material.alphaToCoverage = false; n.leaves.material.needsUpdate = true; }
off: for (const n of window.__cw.app.world.forest.near) { n.leaves.material.alphaToCoverage = true; n.leaves.material.needsUpdate = true; }
